# Hallmark Integration Playbook

## When to Use
- Early visual exploration for hero/landing concepts.
- Redesign experiments where current structure feels generic.
- Style discovery from references (without cloning).

## When Not to Use
- Accessibility sign-off stage.
- Token governance definition stage.
- Final UX acceptance without BoostDesign validation.

## Minimal Sequence
1. Run Hallmark exploration.
2. Convert visual output into semantic tokens.
3. Run UX/a11y consistency checks.
4. Produce a handoff report with accepted and rejected visual decisions.

## Acceptance Rule
A Hallmark-assisted output is only acceptable if it passes:
- WCAG AA requirements.
- Component-state completeness.
- Design-token consistency.
